user.title: Connect Paperless Workflows
user.description: Connects Paperless-ngx. Document views are configured afterwards in Options.

reconfigure.title: Update Paperless connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the token empty to keep the current one. Views are preserved.

abort.already_configured: This Paperless instance is already configured.

delete_view.title: Delete a view
delete_view.description: The entities belonging to this view will be removed after reload.

view_basic.title: 1 · Basics
view_basic.description: Give the view a clear name. You can create any number of views.

view_tags.title: 2 · Tag filters
view_tags.description: Any means at least one tag, all means every selected tag. Excluded tags always remove a document.

view_exclusions.title: 4 · Exclusions
view_exclusions.description: Documents matching one of these values are excluded.

view_search.title: 4 · Search and expert filters
view_search.description: Expert filters are optional JSON parameters from the Paperless document API, for example {"has_custom_fields": true}.

view_presentation.title: 5 · Document display
view_presentation.description: Only selected details are exposed to Home Assistant. The size is automatically bounded.

view_metrics.title: 6 · Metrics and grouping
view_metrics.description: Select any numeric fields to sum. Grouping contains counts and those sums per group.

error.invalid_json: Enter a JSON object with valid Paperless filters.
